description_en: Queries the details of a custom monitoring alert rule
description_zh: 调用GetRemind接口，获取自定义监控报警规则的详情
name: GetRemind

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom monitoring rule
parameters.name: remind_id

Data.description_en: The details of the custom monitoring rule
Data.description_zh: 自定义监控规则的详情

AlertInterval.description_en: The minimum alert interval, in seconds
AlertInterval.description_zh: 最小报警间隔，单位为秒

items.description_en:
The alert method. Valid values:
MAIL: email.
SMS: text message.
<props="intl">Regions that support SMS alerts: Singapore, Malaysia (Kuala Lumpur), and Germany (Frankfurt).</props><props="china">PHONE: phone call. This method is supported only in DataWorks Professional Edition or a higher edition.</props>
items.description_zh:
报警的方式，取值如下：
MAIL（邮件）
SMS（短信）
<props="intl">可使用短信告警的地域为：新加坡、马来西亚（吉隆坡）、德国（法兰克福）。</props><props="china">PHONE（电话，仅DataWorks专业版及以上版本支持）。</props>

AlertTargets.description_en: The alert recipients. For multiple types of alert recipients, refer to the Receivers response parameter
AlertTargets.description_zh: 报警接收人说明。多类型告警接收人参考出参Receivers

items.description_en:
If AlertUnit is OWNER, an empty value is returned.
If AlertUnit is OTHER, the Alibaba Cloud UID of the specified user is returned.
If AlertUnit is SHIFT_SCHEDULE, the ID of the duty roster is returned
items.description_zh:
当AlertUnit（报警接收人）为OWNER（节点任务责任人）时，返回空。
当AlertUnit（报警接收人）为OTHER（指定的人）时，返回指定用户的阿里云UID。
当AlertUnit（报警接收人）为SHIFT_SCHEDULE（值班表）时，返回值班表ID

AlertUnit.description_en:
The alert recipient type. For multiple types of alert recipients, refer to the Receivers response parameter. Valid values:
OWNER: task owner.
OTHER: specified user.
SHIFT_SCHEDULE: duty roster
AlertUnit.description_zh:
报警接收对象类型，多类型告警接收人参考出参Receivers。
OWNER（任务责任人）
OTHER（指定的人）
SHIFT_SCHEDULE（值班表）

items.description_en: The ID of the task in the allowlist. Tasks in the allowlist are ignored during monitoring
items.description_zh: 白名单中的任务ID，在监控时会被忽略

Baselines.description_en: The list of baselines for monitoring by the rule when the RemindUnit object type is BASELINE
Baselines.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为BASELINE（基线）时，该规则监控的基线列表

BizProcesses.description_en: The list of business flows for monitoring by the rule when the RemindUnit object type is BIZPROCESS
BizProcesses.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为BIZPROCESS（业务流程）时，该规则监控的业务流程列表

BizId.description_en: The ID of the business flow

BizProcessName.description_en: The name of the business flow

Detail.description_en:
If the RemindType trigger condition is FINISHED, an empty value is returned.

If the RemindType trigger condition is UNFINISHED, the value is returned in the {"hour":23,"minu":59} format. The value of hour ranges from 0 to 47, and the value of minu ranges from 0 to 59.

If the RemindType trigger condition is ERROR, an empty value is returned.

If the RemindType trigger condition is CYCLE_UNFINISHED, the value is returned in the {"1":"05:50","2":"06:50","3":"07:50","4":"08:50","5":"09:50","6":"10:50","7":"11:50","8":"12:50","9":"13:50","10":"14:50","11":"15:50","12":"16:50","13":"17:50","14":"18:50","15":"19:50","16":"20:50","17":"21:50","18":"22:50","19":"23:50","20":"24:50","21":"25:50"} format. The key in the JSON string is the cycle number, which ranges from 1 to 288. The value is the time by which the cycle must be completed for the cycle, in the hh:mm format. The value of hh ranges from 0 to 47, and the value of mm ranges from 0 to 59.

If the RemindType trigger condition is TIMEOUT, the value is returned in seconds, such as 1800. This indicates that an alert is triggered if the node runs for more than 30 minutes
Detail.description_zh:
当RemindType（触发条件）为FINISHED（完成）时，返回空。

当RemindType（触发条件）为UNFINISHED（未完成）时，返回格式为{"hour":23,"minu":59}。hour的取值范围为[0,47]，minu的取值范围为[0,59]。

当RemindType（触发条件）为ERROR（出错）时，返回空。

当RemindType（触发条件）为CYCLE_UNFINISHED（周期未完成）时，返回格式为{"1":"05:50","2":"06:50","3":"07:50","4":"08:50","5":"09:50","6":"10:50","7":"11:50","8":"12:50","9":"13:50","10":"14:50","11":"15:50","12":"16:50","13":"17:50","14":"18:50","15":"19:50","16":"20:50","17":"21:50","18":"22:50","19":"23:50","20":"24:50","21":"25:50"}。JSON字符串key为周期号，取值范围为[1,288]。value为该周期对应的未完成时间，格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]。

当RemindType（触发条件）为TIMEOUT（运行超时）时，返回格式为1800，单位为秒。即从开始运行起，运行超过30分钟触发报警

DndEnd.description_en: The end time of the do-not-disturb period, in the hh:mm format. The value of hh ranges from 0 to 23, and the value of mm ranges from 0 to 59
DndEnd.description_zh: 免打扰截止时间，格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,23]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]

DndStart.description_en: The start time of the do-not-disturb period, in the hh:mm format. The value of hh ranges from 0 to 23, and the value of mm ranges from 0 to 59
DndStart.description_zh: 免打扰起始时间，格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,23]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]

Founder.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the user who created the custom monitoring rule
Founder.description_zh: 自定义监控规则创建人的阿里云UID

Nodes.description_en: The list of nodes for monitoring by the rule when the RemindUnit object type is NODE
Nodes.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为NODE（任务节点）时，该规则监控的节点列表

Owner.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the node owner

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the node belongs

Projects.description_en: The list of workspaces for monitoring by the rule when the RemindUnit object type is PROJECT
Projects.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为PROJECT（工作空间）时，该规则监控的工作空间列表

RemindId.description_en: The ID of the custom monitoring rule

RemindType.description_en: The trigger condition. Valid values: FINISHED (completed), UNFINISHED (not completed), ERROR (error occurred), CYCLE_UNFINISHED (epoch uncompleted), and TIMEOUT (timeout)
RemindType.description_zh: 触发条件，包括FINISHED（完成）、UNFINISHED（未完成）、ERROR（出错）、CYCLE_UNFINISHED（周期未完成）和TIMEOUT（运行超时）

Robots.description_en: The webhook URLs of the DingTalk chatbots
Robots.description_zh: 钉钉群机器人的webhook地址列表

Specifies whether to mention all members. Valid values:
true: yes.
false: no
